title: First call from the canal household

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: We need drinking water. This is the household by the market canal.

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: Song District, Phrae, near the invented blue shutter shop.

transcript_stream.speaker: operator
transcript_stream.text: Has anyone called us about this already?

transcript_stream.speaker: caller
transcript_stream.text: I don't think so. First time.
